blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.
blocks.zh: 3D对象组成对于数字内容创建和机器人模拟至关重要,同时也是基础模型中物理智能的关键测试台. 以前的方法要么利用大型语言模型直接预测对象坐标,要么利用基因扩散前期合成复合图像进行视觉对齐,两者都依赖于数字空间的静态前期. 然而,这些方法与诸如精确悬挂、重力驱动的安放和隐蔽等复杂成分相冲突,因为这些任务需要互动的建造过程,包括全球规划、精细调整和物理模拟。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议通过物剂勘探和物理模拟,为3D组成建立一个物理-空间地面物剂框架,使刚性、清晰和可变形的物体能够普遍交互组装。 事实证明,在这项工作中直接应用香草有限责任公司(vanilla LLMs)或VLM(VLMs)是不够的,因为目前的模型本身缺乏基于实体的理解和互动的构建经验。 为了克服这一局限性,我们设计了一个合作的向导反馈架构:一个大会代理侧重于全球步骤规划和粗细调整的几何学和动因推理,而一个批评代理则针对模拟状态诊断和精细的闭路修正的接触动态提出批评。 此外,行动路由器将语义规划和分析映射到模拟器内可执行的物理原始物上,而任务特定的自演技能库将历史的试验和反射反馈反馈到可重复使用的经验中,提高成功率,尽量减少探索尝试。 在艾萨克·西姆(Isaac Sim)内部的广泛实验表明,PhySGA在亲和性,物理可信性和视觉质量方面大大超过了现有的方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D object composition aims to construct physically and functionally coherent interactions among independent object assets [ 25 ] . Empowering AI agents to construct complex interactive tasks within dynamic simulators is of paramount importance, as it yields scalable, physically grounded environments that directly enhance the capabilities of embodied models [ 46 ] . Furthermore, this interactive construction establishes a rigorous standard for evaluating the true physical intelligence of foundational models. Unlike conventional benchmarks that rely on static visual question answering [ 10 , 5 ] , 3D composition forces models to translate semantic understanding into executable physical actions, using direct simulation feedback to explicitly validate their reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 三维对象组成旨在构建独立对象资产之间物理和功能上一致的相互作用[25]. 赋予人工智能代理人在动态模拟器内构建复杂互动任务的权力至关重要,因为它会产生可扩展的、基于实体的环境,直接增强所体现模型的能力[46]。 此外,这种互动结构为评估基础模型的真正物理智能确立了严格的标准。 与依赖静态视觉问题回答[10,5]的常规基准不同,3D成分迫使模型将语义理解转化为可执行的物理动作,使用直接模拟反馈来明确验证其推理能力.

blocks.en: Earlier scene synthesis methods place objects using predefined rules or heuristic spatial relations extracted from annotated 3D datasets [ 7 ] . Recently, foundation models have driven two dominant routes for 3D composition. The language-driven route uses LLMs to directly predict object coordinates from text instructions [ 9 ] . Agentic frameworks like SAGE [ 42 ] and SceneSmith [ 24 ] extend this approach by employing tool-use to iteratively adjust hierarchical placements. Yet, their core mechanisms remain heavily dependent on semantic layout priors. The vision-driven route relies on 2D generative models to create an image of the target composition. This image subsequently guides the spatial positioning of 3D objects using diffusion priors [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期的场景合成方法将使用预定义规则或从注释3D数据集提取的热力空间关系来放置物体[7]. 最近,基础模型驱动了三维构成的两种主导路线. 语言驱动的路由使用LLMs从文本指令直接预测对象坐标[9]. SAGE[42]和SceneSmith[24]等代理框架通过使用工具来迭代调整等级设置,扩展了这种方法. 然而,它们的核心机制仍然严重依赖语义排版前身。 视觉驱动的路由依赖于2D基因模型来创建目标成分的图像. 此图像随后使用扩散前缀来引导3D天体的空间定位[31].

blocks.en: However, these methods primarily rely on static priors in digital space, namely knowledge of object positions and relations encoded in language models or diffusion priors, struggling with complex 3D object compositions (e.g., precise hanging, gravity-driven settling, and hidden containment). This is because precise hanging requires precise multi-view observation and exact spatial alignment; gravity-driven settling must explicitly utilize physical simulation under gravitational dynamics; and hidden containment involves a sequence of interactive kinematic actions. Looking back at these approaches, the language-driven branch struggles in these scenarios because it learns plausible static layouts but lacks experiential data for complex interactions, while the final state of physical equilibrium is notoriously difficult to express precisely in text. Equally problematic, the vision-driven branch prioritizes visual plausibility, which rarely equates to physical validity, proving fatal for fine-grained assembly. Therefore, a fundamental challenge in complex interactions is realizing target relations while strictly adhering to physical laws. We argue that a reliable approach is to ground the composition directly in physical space, assembling objects step-by-step in an iterative manner. This preserves physical validity at each step and ultimately ensures relation satisfaction. Intuitively, this mirrors how humans assemble objects in the real world: not through a one-shot prediction, but through a continuous loop of planning, adjusting, and utilizing physical feedback.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法主要依赖于数字空间的静态前传,即对语言模型中编码的物体位置和关系的知识或扩散前传,与复杂的三维物体组成(如精确悬挂,重力驱动沉淀,以及隐藏封存)纠缠在一起. 这是因为精确的悬挂需要精确的多视图观测和精确的空间对齐;重力驱动的沉淀必须在引力动力学下明确利用物理模拟;隐藏的封存涉及一系列互动的动能动作. 回顾这些方法,语言驱动的分支在这些情景中挣扎,因为它学习了可信的静态布局,但缺乏复杂的相互作用的经验数据,而物理平衡的最终状态却臭名昭著地难以在文字中准确表达. 同样有问题的是,由视觉驱动的分支将视觉可信度列为优先事项,这很少等同于物理有效性,证明对精致的组装来说是致命的. 因此,复杂互动的一个基本挑战是实现目标关系,同时严格遵守实体法。 我们认为,一种可靠的办法是将构成直接放在物理空间上,以迭代的方式逐步集合物体。 这保持了每个步骤的物理有效性,并最终确保关系满足。 直观地,这反映了人类在现实世界中如何组装物体:不是通过一弹一弹的预测,而是通过不断循环的规划,调整,以及利用物理反馈.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose PhySGA, formulating 3D object composition as an interactive assembly process in physical space, inspired by how humans assemble objects in the real world, as illustrated in Figure 1 . To achieve this, we design a collaborative Feedforward-Feedback architecture tailored for physical interaction. The Assembly Agent conducts kinematic reasoning to formulate a global plan, executing metric-grounded coarse adjustments to achieve a reliable preliminary correction. Subsequently, the Critic Agent analyzes simulated motion and contact feedback to diagnose physical failures, performing pixel-grounded fine-grained corrections until the target relation reaches physical equilibrium. To bridge high-level semantic reasoning and low-level simulation execution, we introduce modular Action Routers that seamlessly convert agent predictions into exact geometric, articulated, and velocity commands. Finally, we maintain a Self-Evolving Skill Library that distills historical interaction memories, allowing the agents to retrieve past experience to avoid repeating failures and facilitate continuous experience reuse.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出PhySGA, 将三维物体组成作为物理空间的交互式集合过程, 灵感来自人类如何在现实世界中组装物体, 如图1所示。 为了实现这一目标,我们设计了一个配合FeedForward-Feedback架构,适合物理交互. 议会代理人进行动因推理,以制定全球计划,实施基于尺度的粗糙调整,实现可靠的初步更正。 随后,批评代理人分析模拟运动和接触反馈以诊断物理故障,进行像素基质的精细修正,直到目标关系达到物理平衡. 为了连接高层次的语义推理和低层次的模拟执行,我们引入了模块化的动作路由器,将代理预测无缝转换成精确的几何,清晰,速度指令. 最后,我们维持一个自我进化技能库,该库可以提炼历史互动记忆,使特工们能够检索过去的经验,以避免重复失败,促进连续经验的再利用.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose PhySGA, formulating 3D object composition as an interactive assembly process grounded in dynamic physical space, ensuring that complex target relations are constructed upon strict physical validity. • We design a comprehensive agentic framework featuring a Feedforward-Feedback paradigm driven by an Assembly Agent and a Critic Agent for global planning and precise visual correction, modular Action Routers for executing decoupled physical commands, and a Self-Evolving Skill Library for historical experience reuse. • Extensive experiments in Isaac Sim across rigid, articulated, and deformable tasks demonstrate that PhySGA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing a scalable solution for complex task construction in simulators while effectively unlocking the latent physical intelligence of foundational models.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们建议PhySGA, 将3D对象构成作为基于动态物理空间的互动集合过程,确保复杂的目标关系建立在严格的物理有效性基础上。 我们设计了一个全面的代理框架,其特点是由一个大会代理人和一个负责全球规划和精确视觉矫正的批评代理人驱动的Feedforward-Feedback范式,一个用于执行脱钩物理指令的模块化行动路由器,以及一个用于历史经验再利用的自演技能库。 · Isaac Sim的广泛的实验跨越了僵硬,清晰,可变形的任务,表明PhySGA的性能大大超过最先进的方法,为模拟器的复杂任务构建提供了可扩展的解决方案,同时有效解锁了基础模型的潜在物理智能.

blocks.en: We propose PhySGA, formulating 3D object composition as an interactive assembly process grounded in dynamic physical space, ensuring that complex target relations are constructed upon strict physical validity.
blocks.zh: 我们提出PhySGA,将3D对象组成形成一个基于动态物理空间的交互式集合过程,确保复杂的目标关系建立在严格的物理有效性上.

blocks.en: We design a comprehensive agentic framework featuring a Feedforward-Feedback paradigm driven by an Assembly Agent and a Critic Agent for global planning and precise visual correction, modular Action Routers for executing decoupled physical commands, and a Self-Evolving Skill Library for historical experience reuse.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个全面的代理框架,其特点是由一个大会代理人和一个负责全球规划和精确视觉矫正的批评代理人驱动的Feedforward-Feedback范式,一个用于执行脱钩物理指令的模块化行动路由器,以及一个用于历史经验再利用的自演技能库。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments in Isaac Sim across rigid, articulated, and deformable tasks demonstrate that PhySGA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing a scalable solution for complex task construction in simulators while effectively unlocking the latent physical intelligence of foundational models.
blocks.zh: 在艾萨克·西姆(Isaac Sim)中跨越刚性,清晰,可变形任务的广泛实验表明,PhySGA的性能大大超过最先进的方法,为模拟器中复杂的任务构建提供了可扩展的解决方案,同时有效解锁了基础模型的潜在物理智能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Simulation Scene Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 模拟场景生成

blocks.en: Simulation scene generation provides interactive environments for training embodied agents. Early approaches construct these environments through procedural rules [ 7 , 27 , 26 ] or by learning distributions over static object layouts [ 23 , 34 , 36 , 29 , 37 ] . Recent language-guided methods, such as Holodeck and SceneWeaver [ 46 , 45 ] , advance this field by directly translating textual instructions into object selections and spatial arrangements [ 15 ] . Language agents can interleave reasoning with actions and use environmental observations to guide subsequent decisions [ 47 ] . To further refine these layouts, agentic frameworks like SAGE [ 42 ] and SceneSmith [ 24 ] incorporate iterative tool use alongside visual or physical critics. However, these language-driven pipelines primarily formulate generation as predicting static coordinates, treating physical simulation merely as a binary verification step. They lack the capacity to handle complex relations that require continuous interaction. To address this, PhySGA bypasses one-shot coordinate prediction by embedding the agent within the simulator, driving composition through step-by-step physical execution.
blocks.zh: 模拟场景生成为培训包含的代理提供了互动环境. 早期方法通过程序规则[7、27、26]或通过学习在静止物体布局上的分布[23、34、36、29、37]构建这些环境。 最近的语言指导方法,如Holodeck和SceneWeaver[46,45],通过直接将文本指令翻译为对象选择和空间安排[15],推进这个领域. 语言代理人可以将推理与行动进行交互,并利用环境观测来指导随后的决定[47]. 为了进一步完善这些布局,SAGE[42]和SceneSmith[24]等代理框架将迭代工具与视觉或物理批评者结合使用. 然而,这些语言驱动的管道主要将生成作为预测静态坐标,仅作为二进制验证步骤处理。 它们缺乏处理需要持续互动的复杂关系的能力。 为了解决这个问题,PhySGA通过将剂嵌入模拟器内来绕过一发坐标预测,通过一步步的物理执行驱动成分.

blocks.en: 2.2 3D Object Composition
blocks.zh: 2.2 三维物体组成

blocks.en: 3D object composition aims to establish functional and spatial relations among distinct 3D objects. Previous research explores spatial arrangements across different scales. At the scene level, methods like SimRecon [ 41 ] and PhyRecon [ 19 ] reconstruct 3D scenes from visual observations [ 8 , 13 , 14 , 39 , 20 , 40 ] . At the part level, methods such as Jigsaw [ 17 ] assemble fractured pieces [ 30 ] by matching local geometries. Shifting the focus toward complete object composition , Interact3D [ 31 ] leverages diffusion priors to guide the geometric registration of independent assets. However, these approaches rely heavily on visual alignment to recover static terminal poses, which does not guarantee physical plausibility. Crucially, pure visual alignment completely fails on complex interactions: gravity-driven settling dictates dynamic physical simulation to determine the final resting state, and hidden containment involves visually occluded target regions, rendering image-based matching ineffective. PhySGA overcomes these limitations by casting composition as a closed-loop physical construction problem, ensuring that object relations are rigorously validated by physical laws.
blocks.zh: 三维对象组成旨在建立不同三维对象之间的功能和空间关系. 以往的研究探索了不同尺度的空间安排. 在现场层面,SimRecon[41]和Phyrecon[19]从视觉观察重建3D场景[8,13,14,39,20,40]等方法. 在部分层面,Jigsaw[17]等方法通过匹配当地几何来组装断裂片[30]. 将重点转移到完整的对象组成上,Interact3D[31] 利用扩散前科指导独立资产的几何登记. 然而,这些方法严重依赖视觉对齐来恢复静态终端的姿势,这并不能保证物理上的可信度. 关键是,纯视觉对接在复杂的相互作用上完全失败:重力驱动的沉淀决定了动态物理模拟以确定最终休息状态,而隐蔽的封存涉及视觉上渗漏的目标区域,使得基于图像的匹配无效. PhySGA通过铸造成分作为闭锁式物理构造问题来克服这些局限性,确保物体关系得到物理定律的严格验证.

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluating Physical Intelligence
blocks.zh: 2.3 评价物理情报

blocks.en: Evaluating physical intelligence in foundation models has increasingly drawn attention [ 5 ] . Current benchmarks primarily probe this capability through visual question answering, requiring models to infer spatial relations [ 10 , 28 ] , metric quantities [ 44 ] , or physical dynamics [ 48 , 4 ] from static images or videos [ 33 , 5 ] . Concurrently, experiential language agents demonstrate that models can improve over time by accumulating trial-and-error feedback [ 18 , 2 , 32 , 49 ] or self-evolving skills across episodes [ 35 , 43 , 50 ] . However, passive visual questioning is often insufficient to capture the complexities of real-world physics. The most rigorous testbed for physical intelligence is executable construction within a simulator, where semantic reasoning must be validated by dynamic physical interaction. PhySGA adopts this paradigm, evaluating and enhancing the physical understanding of agents through continuous simulation feedback rather than static predictions.
blocks.zh: 在基础模型中评价物理情报越来越引起注意[5]. 目前的基准主要通过视觉问题回答来探究这种能力,要求模型从静态图像或视频推断空间关系[10,28],度量[44],或物理动态[48,4] [33,5]. 同时,经验语言代理人表明,模型可以通过积累试验和过敏反馈[18、2、32、49]或自演技能在各集[35、43、50]中不断改进。 然而,被动的视觉质疑往往不足以捕捉现实世界物理学的复杂性. 物理智能最严格的测试标准是在模拟器内可执行的构造,其中语义推理必须通过动态物理交互来验证. PhySGA采用这种范式,通过持续的模拟反馈而不是静态预测来评价和增强对物剂的物理了解.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We present PhySGA, a physics-space grounded agentic framework for interactive 3D composition, as illustrated in Figure 2 . Section 3.1 presents the task formulation, the overall architecture, and the unified asset pipeline. Section 3.2 introduces the collaborative high-level agents, while Sections 3.3 and 3.4 detail the modular action routing and self-evolving skills, respectively.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们介绍PhySGA,这是一个用于交互式三维构成的物理-空间基物剂框架。 第3.1节介绍了任务拟订、总体结构和统一资产管道。 第3.2节介绍了协作性高级别人员,第3.3和3.4节分别详细介绍了模块化行动路线和自我发展技能。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the PhySGA framework. Driven by a collaborative Feedforward-Feedback architecture, the Assembly Agent executes metric-grounded coarse adjustments, while the Critic Agent performs pixel-grounded fine-grained corrections via simulation feedback. Action Routers translate these semantic decisions into decoupled physical commands, and a Self-Evolving Skill Library distills successful interactions into reusable skills.
blocks.zh: 图2:PhySGA框架概述. 在合作FeedForward-Feedback架构的驱动下,大会代理执行基于参数的粗度调整,而批评代理则通过模拟反馈执行像素基于精度的校正. 动作路由器将这些语义决定翻译为脱节的物理命令,一个自演技能库将成功的相互作用蒸馏成可重复使用的技能.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of PhySGA
blocks.zh: 3.1 公共卫生和空间局概览

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Interactive Composition Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 互动构成

blocks.en: Given a natural-language instruction q q and a pair of independently instantiated, simulation-ready 3D assets 𝒜 = { a 1 , a 2 } \mathcal{A}=\{a_{1},a_{2}\} , the goal is to construct a physically realizable composition 𝒞 ∗ \mathcal{C}^{*} from an initial simulator state s 0 ∗ s_{0}^{*} . Previous methods predominantly formulate this task as a one-shot prediction of final relative object poses, bypassing the physical interaction trajectory. However, complex compositions inherently depend on continuous contact dynamics and intermediate state transitions. We therefore formulate 3D object composition as an iterative physical construction process. Starting from s 0 ∗ s_{0}^{*} , the composition is achieved through a sequence of state transitions utilizing a comprehensive set of operations, including geometric transformations (translation, rotation, scale), dynamic velocity assignments, and physical simulation. This generalized iterative representation can be written as: s k = Φ ⁡ ( s k − 1 , a k ) , s_{k}=\Phi(s_{k-1},a_{k}), (1) where a k a_{k} represents an applied adjustment or simulation step at iteration k k , and Φ \Phi denotes the environment transition function. This step-by-step evolution continues until it yields the final target composition 𝒞 ∗ = s K \mathcal{C}^{*}=s_{K} .
3.1.2 Feedforward-Feedback Agentic Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 Feedforward-Feedback 代理架构

blocks.en: To execute this generalized iterative process, we design a hierarchical architecture comprising two high-level agents. The Assembly Agent ( π Asm \pi_{\mathrm{Asm}} ) governs the outer loop of feedforward construction, leveraging geometric and kinematic reasoning to formulate N N -step plans and execute coarse metric adjustments. For the n n -th step, it applies adjustments to the previously validated state s n − 1 ∗ s_{n-1}^{*} , producing a new state s n s_{n} . If this step requires physical validation, s n s_{n} initiates a pre-simulation state s n , 0 s_{n,0} . The Critic Agent ( π Crit \pi_{\mathrm{Crit}} ) manages the conditional inner loop of feedback refinement. During the r r -th round, the simulator 𝒮 \mathcal{S} evaluates this state, and the Critic Agent applies fine-grained corrections based on the simulated physical evidence to produce the revised state s n , r + 1 s_{n,r+1} . Once the physical requirements are satisfied, the validated state returns to the feedforward process as s n ∗ s_{n}^{*} . The final target composition is achieved upon the completion of all N N steps, yielding 𝒞 ∗ = s N ∗ \mathcal{C}^{*}=s_{N}^{*} . blocks.en: 3.1.3 Unified Asset Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 统一资产管道

blocks.en: PhySGA processes generated rigid assets using GPT Image 2 [ 22 ] and SAM 3D Objects [ 3 ] alongside articulated and deformable assets retrieved from ArtVIP [ 12 ] and GarmentLab [ 16 ] through a unified pipeline. To provide the high-level agents with consistent observations across diverse asset types, we standardize all assets using a shared metadata schema that explicitly records semantics, metric geometry, canonical orientation, and physical properties. We additionally provide standardized CAD-style orthographic multi-view renderings with metric annotations to facilitate accurate spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: PhySGA程序利用GPT图像2[22]和SAM 3D对象[3]生成了刚性资产,同时通过统一的管道从ArtVIP[12]和GarmentLab中提取了清晰和可变形的资产。 为了向高级别代理人提供不同资产类型一致的观察,我们利用一个共同的元数据计划,将所有资产标准化,这个计划明确记录语义、度量几何、犬形定向和物理属性。 此外,我们还提供标准化的CAD式正体多视图渲染,并附有参数说明,以便利准确的空间推理。

blocks.en: 3.2 Collaborative Dual-Agent Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 协作的双重代理架构

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Shared State Machine Design
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 共享国家机器设计

blocks.en: To effectively explore the interactive assembly process, we structure both the Assembly and Critic agents as persistent state machines. Unlike standard one-shot coordinate prediction, this cyclic formulation endows the agents with temporal awareness and environment-conditioned reasoning capabilities. The interaction cycle unfolds through a unified sequence of four cognitive phases: Observe , Decide , Execute , and Validate . Formally, at any interaction timestep t t , an active agent i ∈ { Asm , Crit } i\in\{\mathrm{Asm},\mathrm{Crit}\} begins in the Observe phase, processing the current simulator observation o t o_{t} alongside its historical memory ℳ t − 1 i \mathcal{M}_{t-1}^{i} . Based on this context, the agent transitions to the Decide phase to formulate a geometric or physical adjustment, outputting a natural-language instruction d t i d_{t}^{i} . During the Execute phase, the Action Router grounds this semantic instruction into a concrete simulator command, yielding a physical execution status. Finally, in the Validate phase, the agent evaluates the outcome. At this juncture, the agent determines the macroscopic control flow: advancing to the next step if the current requirements are satisfied, or looping back to initiate another attempt if they are not. Regardless of success or failure, the executed action and its environmental consequence are immediately assimilated into the current memory ℳ t i \mathcal{M}_{t}^{i} to inform the subsequent reasoning cycle.
blocks.zh: 为了有效探索互动的组装过程,我们把大会和批评机构作为顽固的国家机器。 与标准的一发式坐标预测不同,这种循环配体使剂具有时间意识和环境条件的推理能力. 互动循环通过四个认知阶段的统一序列展开:观察、决定、执行和验证。 形式上,在任何交互时间step t t 中,一个活动代理i { Asm, Crit } i\in\ mathrm{Asm},\ mathrm{ Crit} 开始于观测阶段, 处理当前模拟观测 o t o\ t} 与其历史记忆 Mt − 1 i\ mathcal{M}_{t-1} 一起 。 基于这一背景,代理人向决定阶段过渡,以制定几何或物理调整,输出自然语言指令d t i d_{t}^{i}。 在执行阶段,动作路由器将这个语义指令作为具体模拟指令的依据,从而产生实际执行状态. 最后,在验证阶段,代理评估结果. 在此关头,代理人决定宏观控制流:如果满足了当前的要求,则推进到下一步;如果没有,则循环回转以发起另一次尝试。 无论成功还是失败,被执行的行动及其环境后果立即被同化到当前记忆M t i\ mathcal{M}_{t}^{i}中,为接下来的推理周期提供参考.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Assembly Agent
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 集会代理人

Starting from the initial simulator state s 0 s_{0} and the intended assembly relation given by the task instruction, it generates a natural language plan that outlines the whole construction process. Each step provides a semantic description of a target object state and its observable check condition. Given the task instruction q q , task-relevant asset semantics η 𝒜 \eta_{\mathcal{A}} , the initial observation o 0 o_{0} , and its memory ℳ Asm \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{Asm}} , it produces: 𝒫 Asm = Plan Asm ⁡ ( q , η 𝒜 , o 0 , ℳ Asm ) = { ( g k , c k ) } k = 1 K , K ≤ K max . \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{Asm}}=\operatorname{Plan}_{\mathrm{Asm}}\left(q,\eta_{\mathcal{A}},o_{0},\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{Asm}}\right)=\left\{(g_{k},c_{k})\right\}_{k=1}^{K},\qquad K\leq K_{\max}. K\leq KQQXmax]. (3) 每对(g k, c k) (g_{k}, c_{k}) 是一种高级语义规范,它规定了目标状态和核实标准,确立了全局轨迹,而不是规定一个刚性序列的低级命令.

blocks.en: To execute these planned steps, the Assembly Agent transmits the intended adjustment type, the estimated metric value, the target state, and the corresponding verification criteria to its designated Action Router. Operating within an observation space of orthogonal multi-view scene renderings, the agent selects one or more primary views that best expose the interactive region. It then reasons over these selected views to deduce the actual metric values required for the adjustment, thereby further concretizing the target state and its checking criteria. This metric-output paradigm maximally preserves the inherent common-sense spatial reasoning capabilities of vision-language models, making it highly effective for coarse global coordination and structural alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了执行这些计划的步骤,大会代理人将预定的调整类型、估计的计量值、目标状态和相应的核查标准转交给其指定的行动路由器。 在正视多视图场景渲染的观测空间内运行,代理选择一个或多个最能暴露交互区域的主视图. 然后,它就这些选定的观点提出理由,以推断调整所需的实际计量值,从而进一步具体化目标状态及其检查标准。 这种量度输出范式最充分地保留了视觉语言模型固有的常识空间推理能力,使其对粗糙的全球协调和结构调整非常有效.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Critic Agent

In contrast to the Assembly Agent’s feedforward approach, the Critic Agent emulates human trial-and-error refinement based on physical feedback. Following the r r -th physical simulation round of step n n , the Critic Agent diagnoses the failure ξ n , r \xi_{n,r} and identifies a correction aspect α n , r \alpha_{n,r} from the simulated state s n , r sim s_{n,r}^{\mathrm{sim}} . Using this diagnosis alongside the latest observations, it refines the pre-simulation state s n , r s_{n,r} to produce an adjusted state s n , r + 1 s_{n,r+1} , which is then evaluated by a subsequent physical simulation. If the resulting simulation succeeds, s n , r + 1 s_{n,r+1} is returned as the validated state. If it fails, the agent strategically decides whether to proceed with further refinements from the newly adjusted state s n , r + 1 s_{n,r+1} or to roll back to the previous state s n , r s_{n,r} for an alternative correction path. This physical refinement process is formulated as: ( ξ n , r , α n , r ) = Diagnose Crit ⁡ ( q , s n , r sim , ℳ Crit , r ) , \displaystyle(\xi_{n,r},\alpha_{n,r})=\operatorname{Diagnose}_{\mathrm{Crit}}\left(q,s_{n,r}^{\mathrm{sim}},\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{Crit},r}\right), (4) s n , r + 1 = Refine Crit ⁡ ( s n , r , o n , r , ξ n , r , α n , r , ℳ Crit , r ) . \displaystyle s_{n,r+1}=\operatorname{Refine}_{\mathrm{Crit}}\left(s_{n,r},o_{n,r},\xi_{n,r},\alpha_{n,r},\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{Crit},r}\right).

blocks.en: Coarse metric adjustments are often insufficient for achieving precise physical alignment. To address this, we directly leverage the inherent pixel-level alignment capabilities of Vision-Language Models. During the diagnosis phase following a failed simulation, the Critic Agent examines the multi-view observations to identify the specific geometric error. Rather than estimating semantic metric values, the agent directly outputs pixel coordinates, mapping the representative pixel of the manipulated object to its intended position on the target object across multiple views. The Action Router then triangulates these pixel correspondences using calibrated camera projections, converting the precise visual alignment directly into executable commands for the simulator.
blocks.zh: 粗糙的度量调整往往不足以实现精确的物理调整。 为了解决这个问题,我们直接利用Vision-Language Models固有的像素级对齐能力. 在模拟失败后的诊断阶段,批评代理人检查了多视图观测结果,以识别具体的几何误差. 代理不是估计语义度量值,而是直接输出像素坐标,将被操纵对象的代表性像素映射到它通过多种视图在目标对象上的预定位置. 动作路由器然后使用校准的相机投影来对这些像素对应进行三角化,将精确的视觉对齐直接转换成模拟器的可执行命令.

blocks.en: 3.3 Action Router
blocks.zh: 3.3 动作路由器

blocks.en: The Action Router grounds the high-level agents’ semantic targets and adjustment analyses into executable simulator commands through three modular functions. The Geometric Router converts translation, rotation, and uniform scale predictions along 3D orthogonal axes into exact transformations. The Articulated Router maps semantic instructions (e.g., opening a drawer) to corresponding joint movements for articulated objects. The Velocity Router converts release instructions (e.g., throwing forward) into uniform world-space velocities applied to deformable objects prior to simulation. This design seamlessly adapts to diverse object types and explicitly decouples distinct physical variables. Moreover, by separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level physical details, it significantly reduces the cognitive burden on the Assembly Agent and Critic Agent, allowing them to focus exclusively on task planning and spatial alignment.
blocks.zh: 动作路由器通过三个模块函数将高级代理的语义目标和调整分析作为可执行模拟命令的依据。 几何路由器沿3D正交轴将翻译,旋转,和统一的尺度预测转换成精确的转换. 动画路由器将语义指示(如打开抽屉)映射到对清晰对象的相应联合运动. 极速路由器在模拟前将放行指令(如前抛)转换为适用于变形物体的统一世界空间速度. 这种设计能无缝地适应不同的对象类型,并明确解开不同的物理变量. 此外,通过将高层次的语义推理与低层次的物理细节区分开来,大大减轻了大会代理和批评代理的认知负担,使得他们能够完全专注于任务规划和空间协调.

blocks.en: 3.4 Self-Evolving Skill Library
blocks.zh: 3.4 自我发展技能图书馆

blocks.en: To avoid repeating past failures, reduce reasoning time, and streamline planning for tasks with similar physical conditions, we maintain a self-evolving skill library 𝒦 \mathcal{K} . Before executing a new instruction q q , the framework retrieves compatible knowledge from 𝒦 \mathcal{K} to provide the agents with reference strategies. After execution, the consolidated interaction memory ℳ \mathcal{M} and final physical outcome 𝒪 \mathcal{O} are jointly distilled to construct new knowledge or supplement existing skills. This distillation summarizes key insights, such as Assembly planning bottlenecks and the Critic’s root-cause error analyses. The entire retrieval and evolution process is concisely formulated as: p i \displaystyle p_{i} ← p i ⊕ Retrieve ⁡ ( 𝒦 , q ) , \displaystyle\leftarrow p_{i}\oplus\operatorname{Retrieve}(\mathcal{K},q), (5) 𝒦 \displaystyle\mathcal{K} ← Update ⁡ ( 𝒦 , Distill ⁡ ( ℳ , 𝒪 ) ) , \displaystyle\leftarrow\operatorname{Update}\big(\mathcal{K},\operatorname{Distill}(\mathcal{M},\mathcal{O})\big), where ⊕ \oplus denotes appending the retrieved skill to the prompt p i p_{i} of agent i ∈ { Asm , Crit } i\in\{\mathrm{Asm},\mathrm{Crit}\} .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of our method in 3D composition. Following the experimental setup in Section 4.1 , we compare PhySGA against state-of-the-art 3D composition frameworks in Section 4.2 and vanilla coding agents across various base models in Section 4.3 . Finally, Section 4.4 provides comprehensive ablations of our core agentic components.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了广泛的实验来评估我们的方法在三维构成中的有效性. 继第4.1节的实验设置之后,我们比较了PhySGA与第4.2节中最先进的3D组成框架以及第4.3节中各种基模型的香草编码剂。 最后,第4.4节全面介绍了我们的核心代理人部分。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We construct a benchmark of object composition tasks spanning three categories: rigid, articulated, and deformable. Rigid tasks cover physical contact relations (e.g., containment, slotting) between rigid objects. Articulated tasks involve the actuation of kinematic joints, while deformable tasks require physical simulation to naturally settle soft bodies. The benchmark comprises 40 unique tasks (20 rigid, 10 articulated, 10 deformable). Each task is instantiated with three prompt variants featuring different asset descriptions but identical target relations, yielding 120 evaluation scenes in total.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一个涵盖三类物体组成任务的基准:刚性、清晰和可变形。 刚性任务涵盖刚性物体之间的物理接触关系(如封装,档位). 被描述的任务涉及动静关节的激活,而可变形的任务则需要物理模拟来自然地解决软体. 基准包括40项独特的任务(20项僵硬、10项明确、10项可变形)。 每项任务都有三种即时变体,其特点是不同的资产描述,但目标关系相同,总共产生120个评价场景。

blocks.en: We compare PhySGA against three representative systems: SAGE [ 42 ] , SceneSmith [ 24 ] , and Interact3D [ 31 ] . Since SAGE and SceneSmith are hierarchical scene generation frameworks, we primarily compare against their object-level performance. Specifically, we retain the placement and critic agents from SAGE and the manipuland agents from SceneSmith, while omitting room initialization and global layout planning. Each system utilizes its native asset acquisition pipeline, and all final compositions are executed and evaluated in Isaac Sim under a unified protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了PhySGA与三个代表性系统:SAGE [42],SceneSmith [24],以及Interact3D [31]. 由于SAGE和SceneSmith是等级的场景生成框架,我们主要比较他们的对象级性能. 具体地说,我们保留了SAGE的安置和批评代理人以及SceneSmith的manipuland代理人,同时省略了房间初始化和全球布局规划. 每个系统都使用其本土资产获取管道,所有最终组成都按照统一的协议在Isaac Sim执行和评估.

blocks.en: All methods are executed and evaluated in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 4.2.0. In the baseline comparison, GPT-5.5 serves as the base VLM for all VLM-driven reasoning. Each method receives the same 120 language prompts and follows its native pipeline to generate compositions, which are then loaded into Isaac Sim using identical rendering and physical execution configurations.
blocks.zh: 所有方法均在NVIDIA Isaac Sim 4.2.0中执行和评估. 在基线比较中,GPT-5.5是所有VLM驱动推理的基础VLM. 每种方法都得到相同的120种语言的提示,并遵循其本土管道生成成分,然后使用相同的渲染和物理执行配置将成分装入Isaac Sim.

blocks.en: We evaluate composition quality using both physical and visual metrics. Physical metrics include Penetration Rate (PR) and Contact Rate (CR), both ranging from 0 to 1, which measure the average fraction of scenes exhibiting invalid collisions (lower is better) and successful target contacts (higher is better), respectively. For visual metrics, a VLM evaluator scores the multi-view outputs on a scale from 0 to 10. We report Asset Fidelity Score (AFS) for asset fidelity, Composition Overall Score (COS) for overall composition quality, and prominently highlight Relation Fidelity Score (RFS) as the primary indicator of successfully achieving the instructed relation. All visual metrics are averaged across the 120 scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用物理和视觉衡量标准来评价构成质量。 物理度量包括穿透率(PR)和接触率(CR),两者都介于0到1之间,分别测量显示无效碰撞的场景平均分数(较低为更好)和成功的目标接触(较高为更好). 对于视觉度量衡,一名甚高频评价员对多视图产出的评分从0到10。 我们报告资产Fidelity评分(AFS)用于资产忠诚度,构成总体评分(COS)用于总体构成质量,并突出强调关系Fidelity评分(RFS)是成功实现指示关系的主要指标。 所有视觉度量衡均横跨120场景.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 与基线的比较

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Qualitative comparison with baselines. Columns represent distinct compositional tasks across rigid, articulated, and deformable domains, comparing SAGE, SceneSmith, Interact3D, and our PhySGA after physical simulation. PhySGA consistently maintains high-fidelity asset details, satisfies target relations, and yields physically valid compositions.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with Vanilla VLM-based Coding Agents
blocks.zh: 4.3 与基于Vanilla VLM 的编码代理人的比较

blocks.en: We compare vanilla VLM-based coding agents against the same base models instantiated within PhySGA, evaluating Qwen3.8-Max [ 1 ] , Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview [ 11 ] , DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp [ 6 ] , and GPT-5.5 [ 21 ] . All configurations share identical benchmark tasks and asset instances. Therefore, we omit the Asset Fidelity Score (AFS) and focus exclusively on physical and relational metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们比较香草VLM的编码剂与PhySGA内部即时化的同一基模型,评价Quen3.8-Max [1],双子座3.1-Pro-Preview [11],DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp [6],以及GPT-5.5 [21]. 所有配置共享相同的基准任务和资产实例. 因此,我们省略了资产Fidelity评分(AFS),只注重物理和关系衡量标准。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Comparison between vanilla VLM-based coding agents and PhySGA using the same base VLMs. The best and second-best results are shown in bold and underlined, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表2:使用同一基底VLM的香草VLM编码剂与PhySGA的比较. 最佳和次最佳结果分别用黑体和下划线表示。

blocks.en: The vanilla baselines operate as Codex-style coding agents, utilizing a Python sandbox to analyze asset geometry and generate executable scene programs. Table 2 shows that these vanilla agents struggle to realize physically plausible configurations, highlighting an inherent deficit in their native physical intelligence. Conversely, integrating these models into PhySGA consistently reduces penetration and drastically improves relation fidelity across all models. GPT-5.5 achieves the highest overall performance, followed by Qwen3.8-Max. This confirms that our framework effectively unlocks and empowers the latent physical intelligence of foundational models for complex 3D composition.
blocks.zh: 香草基线作为Codex风格的编码代理运行,利用Python沙盒分析资产几何并生成可执行的场景程序. 表2显示,这些香草剂难以实现物理上可行的配置,突出显示其本土的物理智能存在固有的缺陷。 反之,将这些模型纳入PhySGA, 不断降低渗透率,并大大改善所有模型之间的忠诚关系。 GPT-5.5实现了最高的整体性能,其次是Quen3.8-Max. 这证实了我们的框架有效地解锁并增强了复杂三维构成的基础模型的潜在物理智能。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 3 : Ablation study of PhySGA with individual components removed. PhySGA denotes the complete framework with all components enabled.
blocks.zh: 表3:除去个别成分的PhySGA的读取研究. PhySGA表示包含所有已启用组件的完整框架.

blocks.en: We evaluate six ablations of PhySGA under the same experimental settings to assess the contribution of each core component to overall composition quality. w/o Global Planning replaces the complete global plan with isolated step-by-step planning. w/o Metric Adjustment replaces metric estimation by directly predicting pixel-level movement changes. w/o Error Attribution performs direct adjustments without utilizing physical simulation feedback. w/o Pixel Alignment forces the agent to directly predict real-valued spatial movements instead of precise pixel alignments. w/o Action Routers requires the agents to output low-level simulator control codes directly without executing through modular routers. w/o Self-Evolving Skills removes the retrieval of historical experience.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一试验环境下评估六份PhySGA汇编,以评估每个核心组成部分对总体组成质量的贡献。 全球 规划以孤立的逐步规划取代完整的全球计划。 w/o Metric 调整通过直接预测像素级运动变化来取代度量估计. w/o 误差归属不利用物理模拟反馈进行直接调整。 w/o像素对齐迫使剂直接预测真实值的空间运动,而不是精确的像素对齐. w/o 动作路由器要求代理直接输出低级模拟器控制码,而不通过模块路由器执行. w/o 自演技移除了历史经验的检索.

blocks.en: As reported in Table 3 , the complete PhySGA consistently achieves the highest Contact Rate (CR) and visual scores (RFS, COS), alongside the lowest Penetration Rate (PR). Removing any single module leads to a noticeable drop in overall composition quality. This confirms that global planning, coarse-to-fine visual alignment, modular action routing, and self-evolving skills are all indispensable for physically grounded 3D composition.
blocks.zh: 如表3所报告,完整的PhySGA始终达到最高的接触率和视觉分数(RFS,COS),同时达到最低的渗透率(PR)。 任何单一模块的删除导致总体构成质量明显下降。 这证实,全球规划、粗细的视觉对接、模块化的动作路径和自我发展技能,都是基于实体的三维构成所不可或缺的。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose PhySGA, a physics-space grounded agentic framework for interactive 3D object composition across rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. We design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture in which the Assembly Agent uses geometric and kinematic reasoning for global assembly planning and metric-grounded coarse adjustments, while the Critic Agent diagnoses composition failures from simulated contact dynamics and performs pixel-grounded fine adjustments. Action Routers translate their decisions into executable simulator commands, and a Self-Evolving Skill Library distills experience from complete assembly runs into reusable skills for subsequent tasks. Experiments in Isaac Sim show improved relation fidelity and overall composition quality over existing methods and vanilla VLM-based coding agents, with ablation studies further supporting the effectiveness of the key design choices.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出PhySGA,即一个物理-空间基物剂框架,用于跨刚性、清晰和可变形物体的交互式三维物体组成。 我们设计了一个协作的Feedforward-feedback架构,其中大会代理人使用几何学和动因学推理来进行全球组装规划,并进行以公尺为基础的粗度调整,而批评代理人则从模拟接触动态中判断组成故障,并进行以像素为基础的细度调整。 Action Routers将其决定翻译为可执行模拟器命令,一个自演化的Skill Library从完整的组装中提炼出的经验运行为后续任务的可重复使用的技能. Isaac Sim的实验显示,相对于现有方法和基于香草VLM的编码剂而言,关系忠心度和总体组成质量都得到了提高,同时对关键设计选择的有效性给予了进一步支持。
